theme: Light mode primary with warm gray (#F3F4F6) and vibrant orange (#F97316) accents

typography.headings: Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans, font-bold, tracking-tight
typography.body: Inter or DM Sans, text-base, leading-relaxed

layout_specification.sidebar: Collapsible responsive left sidebar with accordion curriculum navigation
layout_specification.header: Top header with breadcrumbs and user profile icon

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the responsive layout with collapsible sidebar, accordion menu for curriculum, breadcrumb header, user profile, and max-width 65ch content area with mock lessons for ESP32 and ESP-IDF.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use data-testid on all interactive and key elements
Do not use transparent header backgrounds
Ensure accessible contrast and clean styling
